started_at_ms.description: Run and build start epoch ms.

signature.description: Opaque provider data: Anthropic's extended-thinking block signature, delivered by `signature_delta`. Empty when the provider issued none. Persisted verbatim and replayed verbatim on the next request of a tool-use conversation; never interpreted. data.description: Opaque encrypted provider data. Persist and replay it verbatim at this position; never interpret, normalize, collapse, or reorder it.

Capability.description: Optional daemon surface a client may probe for. This is the ONE enum decoded tolerantly: an unknown capability string is IGNORED, never a Validation_Error. Tolerant decode is the whole point — a newer daemon advertises a token an older client does not know, and the client must skip it, not reject the frame. Every other enum in this package hard-rejects an unknown value; this one must not.

Response_Error.description: Failed response. Carries `error` instead of `result`; the two never appear together.

Response_Ok.description: Successful server response; carries the typed method result.

Response_Result.description: Runtime result payload tagged by the request method that produced it.

Rule_Action.description: Whether a remembered permission rule allows or denies the matched call.

Rule_Id.description: 16 lowercase hex chars. Identifies one remembered permission rule.

started_at_ms.description: Start epoch ms, or null when canceled before starting.

Run_Error_Code.description: Why a run failed after daemon retry policy was exhausted.

Run_Id.description: Session-scoped, daemon-minted, strictly increasing, never reused.

Run_Kind.description: What kind of run occupies a session.

rounds.description: Number of model/tool round trips used.

Run_Outcome_Canceled.description: A run canceled by the user or daemon. Its timing rides the terminal envelope.

Run_Outcome_Compacted.description: A manual compaction that produced a summary.

Run_Outcome_Failed.description: A run that failed after daemon retry policy was exhausted.

Run_Outcome_Skipped.description: A manual compaction that did nothing.

Run_Outcome_Turn.description: A completed turn: it stopped for a stop reason after some round trips.

rounds.description: Number of model/tool round trips used.

Seq.description: Per-session monotonic sequence number on durable broadcasts.

agent.description: Agent name, when known; omitted if unassigned. Lets a client listing children name the agent without fetching a transcript.

created_by.description: Client that created the session; null for daemon-created child/cron sessions.

max_rounds.description: Live round cap; null means unlimited.

queued.description: Accepted inputs waiting to run. At most LIMITS.max_queued_inputs.

canceled_run.description: Run that was canceled; null if none was active.

cleared_compaction.description: Compaction run canceled alongside; null if none was active.

system_prompt.description: null means no system prompt is sent to the model.

count.description: Deltas shed on this connection since the last delivered marker; never zero.

limit.description: Max messages to return; omit for daemon default.

configs.description: Unique configs resolving every assistant message in `messages`.

has_more.description: Whether older messages exist beyond this page.

messages.description: Page of transcript messages, oldest first in strict message-id order.

Session_List_Item.description: Full compact row returned by session.list and session-index broadcasts. Non-owning; nested slices share the containing frame arena.

limit.description: Page size; omitted means daemon default.

items.description: Rows in final daemon-defined display order.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation; required null on the final page.

total.description: Unique rows in the complete selected view before paging.

Session_Patch.description: Missing field means no change. The system prompt is snapshotted at creation and is not patchable. Non-owning.

max_rounds.description: New round cap; omitted means no change, null clears the cap.

Session_Population.description: Session relationship population searched by session.list.

Session_Population_Children.description: Immediate persistent children of one session.

Session_Population_Job_Runs.description: Sessions created by one cron job.

Session_Population_Top_Level.description: User-facing conversations: root sessions and forks.

limit.description: Max messages to return; omit for daemon default.

configs.description: Unique configs resolving every assistant message in `messages` and `active`.

has_more.description: True exactly when `item.session.message_count` exceeds the number of returned messages.

messages.description: Recent transcript messages, oldest first in strict message-id order.

queued.description: Inputs queued behind the active turn.

sessions.description: Sessions to subscribe to; replaces the prior set.

call_id.description: Provider identity; never used to address the part.

output.description: Accumulated display output streamed so far. Present in a resync snapshot of a running tool, absent in the live transition into `running`. Its UTF-8 byte length is the next `tool.output_delta` offset baseline.

Turn_Provenance.description: Which provider actually produced one assistant turn. Absent on a turn the daemon built before the field existed. `Assistant_Message.config_rev` records the configuration a turn was *requested* under and can be resolved away by a later config change; this records what answered, which is what makes provider-scoped opaque data (a reasoning part's signature) safe to replay: replay it only when the next request goes to the same protocol and model. Non-owning.

model.description: Model id that produced the turn, resolved at request time.

View.description: Display-only rendering hint. Frontends may render natively or ignore. Non-owning.

files.description: Files in the diff. Owner: caller/arena.
Files in the diff. Owner: caller/arena.

parent.description: Parent directory path; null at the filesystem root.

git.description: Git status; null when the root is not a repo.

last_used_model.description: Last model used in this workspace; null if never run.

related_job_ids.description: Cron jobs that referenced the removed workspace.
